content.title: Open the contact page and follow the submissions guidance link
content.intent: Prove the contact page tells the reader to quote a SUB- reference number and routes them to `/my-submissions` for submission help.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning to model the distinct outcome-changing navigation promise separately from the static contact-details display. Pagination, boundary value, negative, auth, and state-flow techniques were not applicable because the source names a single link target and no alternate outcomes or constrained inputs. Budget ceiling is 3 pairs; this scenario was kept because all 2 candidate scenarios fit within budget.
